title: Containerized Issue Router Full-Integration Test Suite
description: Build a reusable, opt-in full-integration suite that runs isolated Issue Router workers in containers and exercises real Kanbus board issues. The suite must support repeatable hard-Mutex contention, expiry/takeover, and explicitly scoped soft-provider behavior, capture/redact worker logs and board/router-state evidence, and enforce disposable test-task boundaries. Successful tasks must remain visible in the configured Review stage; failed issues and diagnostic fixtures must remain available for inspection rather than being closed. Use separate worker containers with independent checkouts and no shared UDS. Keep production service credentials external to source/config files; default and CI-safe runs must not contact live cloud services. Provide documented prerequisites, bounded timeouts, safe failure handling, and an explicit live gate. The suite targets the fixed Issue Router Testing epic ID kbs-d3973c07-13a1-4598-8f32-85e010278121: reuse it when it exists with the expected identity, create it just-in-time if absent, and fail closed on an ID/type/title mismatch.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Complete: the reusable containerized suite (harness, Dockerfile, fake agent, three scenarios, offline tests, docs/ISSUE_ROUTER_INTEGRATION_HARNESS.md) is merged and passes live. Verified live on 2026-09-23 with tools/issue_router_container_integration_harness.py (Docker workers on independent checkouts, no shared UDS, the production Mutex API and MQTT broker, a deterministic fake Codex agent so no model key is needed; disposable test tasks under the fixed epic kbs-d3973c07). hard-race: exactly one of the Python and Rust workers started the task, the other got the documented 'package already claimed' response and made no transition, and the winner's task reached Review with the router comment (test issue kbs-ed894564). soft-duplicate (Mutex disabled, git coordination): passed, one worker started (kbs-5e94f099). expiry-takeover: the lease holder was killed, its 30s lease expired, and a second worker took over and completed the task (kbs-6c66c6a6). PRs: #354 fake-agent mode, #355 scenarios, #357 config and coordination fixes, #358, #362 loser/full-id/start-event/TTL fixes, #356 Rust forge-less run parity. Live findings filed: kbs-f7c9a9 (router event rescan cost), kbs-7d2e34 (long-lived Mutex tokens). Successful test tasks are left in Review and failed ones preserved for inspection.

right_now_summary: The reusable containerized integration runner is being designed with safe live testing and cleanup.
